# PlexUI
> The most flexible UI kit for React. Production-grade components, design tokens and a 9-size scale that AI agents use correctly.

Every example's code: https://plexui.com/llms-full.txt
Vue 3: https://plexui.com/llms-vue.txt

Install: npm install @plexui/ui
Docs: https://plexui.com
Components: 61

## Setup

```css
@layer theme, base, components, utilities;
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@plexui/ui/css";
@source "../node_modules/@plexui/ui";
```

Wrap your app with <PlexUIProvider linkComponent={Link}> from "@plexui/ui/components/PlexUIProvider" (your router's Link, or "a")

Size scale: 3xs, 2xs, xs, sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl, 3xl
Colors: primary, secondary, danger, success, warning, caution, discovery, info
Variants: solid, soft, outline, ghost

---

## Accordion
Vertically stacked panels that expand to reveal content, with one or several items open at a time and full keyboard navigation.
Import: import { Accordion } from "@plexui/ui/components/Accordion"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/accordion
Props:
  - type ("single" | "multiple") default: — — Required. Whether one item or many can be open at a time
  - value (string | string[]) default: — — Controlled open item(s)
  - defaultValue (string | string[]) default: — — Uncontrolled initial open item(s)
  - onValueChange ((value) => void) default: — — Fires when the open item(s) change
  - collapsible (boolean) default: false — When type="single", allow closing the open item
  - disabled (boolean) default: false — Disable every item
  - dir ("ltr" | "rtl") default: "ltr" — Reading direction
  - orientation ("horizontal" | "vertical") default: "vertical" — Layout axis
  - className (string) default: — — Applied to the root <div>
  Accordion.Item:
    - value (string) default: — — Required. Unique identifier used by value / defaultValue
    - disabled (boolean) default: false — Disable this item
    - className (string) default: — — Applied to the item wrapper
Examples: Overview, Single, Multiple, Card

## Alert
Inline message for notices and warnings with semantic colors, variants, a title, a description, action slots, and a dismiss control.
Import: import { Alert } from "@plexui/ui/components/Alert"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/alert
Props:
  - title (ReactNode) — Title displayed in the alert
  - description (ReactNode) — Description text
  - actions (ReactNode) — Actions (for example buttons)
  - actionsPlacement ("end" | "bottom") — Placement of actions; automatic from sizing when unset
  - actionsClassName (string) — Class applied to the actions container
  - color (SemanticColors) default: "primary" — Color scheme
  - variant ("solid" | "soft" | "outline") default: "outline" — Style variant
  - indicator (ReactNode | false) — Custom indicator or false to hide
  - onDismiss (() => void) — Shows the dismiss button when set
  - banner (boolean) default: false — Full-width strip: square corners, lines above and below only
  - className (string) — Class applied to the alert container
Examples: Overview, Colors & variants, Title, Description, Actions, Action placement, Indicator, Dismissible, Banner

## Avatar Group
Stacks user avatars into a single overlapping cluster, with a configurable stacking direction and one size for the whole group.
Import: import { Avatar, AvatarGroup } from "@plexui/ui/components/Avatar"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/avatar-group
Props:
  - children (ReactNode) — The avatars of the group
  - size (number) — Size of all avatars in the group
  - stack ("start" | "end") default: "start" — Stacking direction
  - className (string) — Applied to the group container; other props are not forwarded
Examples: Overview, Stacking direction, Group sizing

## Avatar
An avatar for user identities that shows an initial, a photo or an icon, with overflow counts, semantic colors and roundness options.
Import: import { Avatar } from "@plexui/ui/components/Avatar"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/avatar
Props:
  - name (string) — Display name; used for text initial when no image/icon
  - imageUrl (string) — Absolute URL for image avatar
  - Icon (React.ComponentType) — Icon component for icon avatar
  - size (number) — Width and height in pixels
  - color ("primary" | "secondary" | "success" | "info" | "discovery" | "danger") default: "secondary" — Semantic color for text/icon avatar
  - variant ("soft" | "solid") default: "soft" — Style variant
  - overflowCount (number) — Show overflow count (e.g. +9)
  - className (string) — Applied to the avatar root
  - onClick (() => void) — Makes avatar interactive (renders a button)
  - onPointerDown (() => void) — Makes avatar interactive (renders a button)
Examples: Overview, Text, Image, Icon, Overflow count, Sizing, Colors & variants, Roundness, Interactive

## Badge
Compact label for statuses and inline metadata, with semantic colors, three variants and sizes, icon support, and a loading state.
Import: import { Badge } from "@plexui/ui/components/Badge"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/badge
Props:
  - children (ReactNode) — Content inside the badge
  - color ("secondary" | "success" | "danger" | "warning" | "info" | "discovery" | "caution") default: "secondary" — Semantic color
  - variant ("solid" | "soft" | "outline") default: "soft" — Style variant
  - size ("sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl") default: "sm" — Badge size
  - pill (boolean) default: false — Fully rounded
  - onRemove (MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement>) — Adds a cross at the end of the badge that calls this when pressed
  - removeLabel (string) default: "Remove" — Accessible name of the cross
  - removable (boolean) default: false — Shows the cross as a mark, for a badge inside a control that takes the press
  - className (string) — Class applied to the badge
Examples: Overview, Colors & variants, Size & roundness, Icon, Remove, Loading

## Breadcrumb
The trail of pages that leads to the current one, above a page title, with links, plain steps and the current page.
Import: import { Breadcrumb } from "@plexui/ui/components/Breadcrumb"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/breadcrumb
Props:
  - size ("sm" | "md") default: "md" — Text size: sm above a compact header, md above a page title
  - separator (ReactNode) default: a small chevron — What stands between two items
  - aria-label (string) default: "Breadcrumb" — Name of the navigation landmark
  - className (string) — Applied to the nav element
  Breadcrumb.Item:
    - href (string) — Link destination. Internal paths use the linkComponent of PlexUIProvider
    - to (string) — Router destination, for link components that take to
    - current (boolean) default: false — The current page: plain text marked aria-current="page"
    - onClick ((event: MouseEvent) => void) — Makes an item without a destination act as a button
    - className (string) — Applied to the li element
Examples: Overview, Sizes, Separator, Long trails

## Button Group
Join buttons into a single visual unit for toolbars, steppers, split buttons and search affordances.
Import: import { ButtonGroup } from "@plexui/ui/components/ButtonGroup"

Props:
  - orientation ("horizontal" | "vertical") default: "horizontal" — Direction of the joined items
  - mobileMaterial ("glass" | "flat") default: — — Phone surface with touch.css: "glass" makes the group one glass capsule outside a Toolbar, "flat" keeps the joined buttons in one
  - className (string) default: — — Applied to the root <div>
  ButtonGroup.Text:
    - asChild (boolean) default: false — Render as the passed child (e.g. a <label> tied to an input)
    - className (string) default: — — Applied to the wrapper
Examples: Overview, Orientation, Size, Nested, Separator, Split, Input, Input group, Dropdown menu, Select, Popover

## Button Link
A semantic anchor with full button styling, for internal and external links with icons and block layout.
Import: import { ButtonLink } from "@plexui/ui/components/Button"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/button-link
Props:
  - children (ReactNode) — Content inside the link button
  - color ("primary" | "secondary" | "danger" | "success" | "info" | "discovery" | "caution" | "warning") default: "primary" — Visual color
  - variant ("solid" | "soft" | "outline" | "ghost") default: "solid" — Style variant
  - size ("3xs" | "2xs" | "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl" | "3xl") default: "md" — Control height and typography scale
  - gutterSize ("3xs" | "2xs" | "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl") — Override horizontal padding
  - iconSize ("sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl") — Override icon size
  - href (string) — Link URL
  - to (string | object) — Router link destination (internal)
  - as (ComponentType) — Link component override (e.g. Next Link)
  - external (boolean) — Force external-link behavior
  - opticallyAlign ("start" | "end") — Apply optical negative margin alignment
  - block (boolean) default: false — Full width
  - mobileMaterial ("glass" | "flat") — Phone surface for neutral soft/ghost buttons
  - pill (boolean) default: false — Fully rounded
  - disabled (boolean) default: false — Disable link
  - disabledTone ("relaxed") — Use relaxed visual tone for disabled state
  - className (string) — Custom classes for the root element
  - onClick ((event: MouseEvent) => void) — Called on click, unless disabled
Examples: Overview, Internal link, External link, Colors & variants, Sizing & roundness, Icons, Block, Disabled

## Button
Button with four variants (solid, soft, outline, ghost), eight semantic colors, icon slots, loading, and block layout.
Import: import { Button } from "@plexui/ui/components/Button"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/button
Props:
  - color ("primary" | "secondary" | "danger" | "success" | "info" | "discovery" | "caution" | "warning") default: "primary" — Visual color scheme
  - variant ("solid" | "soft" | "outline" | "ghost") default: "solid" — Button style variant
  - size ("3xs" | "2xs" | "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl" | "3xl") default: "md" — Control height and default gutter/icon size
  - mobileMaterial ("glass" | "flat") — Phone surface for neutral soft/ghost buttons
  - pill (boolean) default: false — Fully rounded corners
  - block (boolean) default: false — Full width
  - uniform (boolean) default: false — Square icon button (width equals height)
  - disabled (boolean) default: false — Visually and accessibly disabled; onClick is not called
  - disabledTone ("relaxed") — Default cursor instead of not-allowed while disabled
  - loading (boolean) default: false — Shows loading indicator
  - inert (boolean) default: loading — Accessibly disabled without visual change
  - selected (boolean) default: false — Selected state styling
  - opticallyAlign ("start" | "end") — Offset gutter for optical alignment
  - gutterSize ("3xs" | "2xs" | "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl") — Horizontal padding size; defaults from size
  - iconSize ("sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl") — Size of icons in children; defaults from size
  - type ("button" | "submit" | "reset") default: "button" — Native button type
  - onClick ((event: MouseEvent) => void) — Called on click, unless disabled
Examples: Overview, Colors & variants, Sizing & roundness, Icons, Block, States, Selected, Optical alignment

## Card
Card surface for composing login flows, sign-up forms, pricing tiles, payment methods, empty states, and stat showcases.
Import: import { Card } from "@plexui/ui/components/Card"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/card
Props:
  - variant ("outline" | "solid" | "ghost") default: "outline" — Visual variant
  - size ("sm" | "md" | "lg") default: "md" — Padding scale
  - interactive (boolean) default: false — Adds hover and focus affordances. Automatic when href is set.
  - href (string) default: — — Renders the Card as a link via the configured LinkComponent.
  - external (boolean) default: auto-detected — Forces target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer" when href is set.
  - as (ComponentType | "a") default: — — Overrides the link component (e.g. next/link).
  - className (string) default: — — Applied to the root element
Examples: Overview, Login, Create project, Payment Method, No team members (empty state), How did you hear about us?, Processing your request, Pricing

## Checkbox
Checkbox for binary on/off selection with solid, pill, and ghost variants, an indeterminate state, and rich labels with inline descriptions.
Import: import { Checkbox } from "@plexui/ui/components/Checkbox"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/checkbox
Props:
  - variant ("solid" | "ghost") default: "solid" — Visual style: solid (filled background) or ghost (checkmark only)
  - pill (boolean) default: false — Fully rounded indicator corners
  - checked (boolean | "indeterminate") — Controlled state
  - defaultChecked (boolean | "indeterminate") — Initial state (uncontrolled)
  - onCheckedChange ((next: boolean) => void) — Called with the next state when it changes
  - label (ReactNode) — Accessible label. Accepts ReactNode for rich content
  - description (ReactNode) — Second line below the label, linked via aria-describedby. Renders only with a label
  - disabled (boolean) default: false — Prevent interaction
  - required (boolean) — Required for form submission
  - name (string) — Form field name
  - value (string) default: "on" — Value when submitted
  - orientation ("left" | "right") default: "left" — Checkbox position relative to the label
  - className (string) — CSS classes applied to the wrapper node
  - id (string) — The id of the checkbox element (generated when omitted)
  - onFocus ((event: FocusEvent) => void) — Called when the checkbox gains focus
  - onBlur ((event: FocusEvent) => void) — Called when the checkbox loses focus
Examples: Overview, With Radio Group, Descriptions, Variants, Pill, Ghost, With description, Indeterminate, Label orientation, Without label, Group with select all, Group with description, With Field, Grouped sections

## Color Picker
"The iOS 26 system color picker: Grid, Spectrum and Sliders, an Opacity slider and saved colors, and the color well that opens it in a popover or, on a phone, a sheet."
Import: import { ColorPicker, ColorWell } from "@plexui/ui/components/ColorPicker"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/color-picker
Props:
  - value (string) — The controlled color, `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa`
  - defaultValue (string) default: "#000000" — The color when it is initially rendered
  - onChange ((value: string) => void) — Called with the next color: `#rrggbb`, or `#rrggbbaa` when it is not opaque
  - supportsAlpha (boolean) default: true — Shows the Opacity slider
  - mode ("grid" | "spectrum" | "sliders") — The controlled way to choose a color
  - defaultMode ("grid" | "spectrum" | "sliders") default: "grid" — The way to choose a color when it is initially rendered
  - onModeChange ((mode) => void) — Called when another way is chosen
  - swatches (string[]) — The controlled saved colors
  - defaultSwatches (string[]) default: [] — The saved colors when it is initially rendered
  - onSwatchesChange ((swatches: string[]) => void) — Called after Add saves the current color or Delete removes one
  - aria-label (string) default: "Colors" — Accessible name of the picker
  ColorWell:
    - value (string | null) — The controlled color, `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa`; `null` shows the well with no color
    - defaultValue (string | null) default: null — The color when it is initially rendered
    - onChange ((value: string) => void) — Called with the color the picker chose
    - size ("sm" | "lg") default: "sm" — 28px or 36px
    - title (string) default: "Colors" — The title of the picker
    - supportsEyedropper (boolean) default: true — Shows the eyedropper where the browser has the EyeDropper API
    - disabled (boolean) default: false — Prevents opening the picker
    - name (string) — Submits the color with the owning form
    - aria-label (string) default: "Color" — Accessible name of the well
    - aria-labelledby (string) — The `id` of the visible label of the well
Examples: Color well, Sizes and states, Picker, Without opacity

## Context Menu
"A menu of actions for an element: a secondary click opens it at the pointer, a touch and hold opens it beside the element over a dimmed page, as iOS 26 context menus do. Its items are the ones of Menu."
Import: import { ContextMenu } from "@plexui/ui/components/ContextMenu"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/context-menu
Props:
  - onOpen (() => void) — Called when the menu opens
  - onClose (() => void) — Called when the menu closes
  ContextMenu.Trigger:
    - children (ReactElement) — The element the menu is for; it receives the handlers
    - disabled (boolean) default: false — The element keeps the browser's own context menu
Examples: Overview, Rounded elements

## Copy Tooltip
A copy-to-clipboard tooltip that wraps any trigger element and confirms when the value has been copied.
Import: import { CopyTooltip } from "@plexui/ui/components/Tooltip"
Import: import { Button } from "@plexui/ui/components/Button"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/copy-tooltip
Props:
  - children (ReactNode) — Trigger element (for example Tooltip.TriggerDecorator)
  - copyValue (string) — Required. Content to copy to clipboard
  - openDelay (number) default: 150 — Tooltip open delay in milliseconds
  - align ("start" | "center" | "end") default: "center" — Preferred tooltip alignment against the trigger
  - alignOffset (number) default: 0 — Offset from start/end alignment in pixels
  - side ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left") default: "top" — Preferred side of the trigger
  - sideOffset (number) default: 5 — Distance from trigger in pixels
  - onCopy ((copied: boolean) => void) — Called once the clipboard write settles, with whether it succeeded. The tooltip says Copied! only after a successful write
Examples: Overview

## Date Input
Masked text input for typing dates and times, with automatic formatting, min and max limits, and validation.
Import: import { DateInput } from "@plexui/ui/components/DateInput"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/date-input
Props:
  - value (DateTime | null) — Required. Selected date (Luxon DateTime)
  - onChange ((date: DateTime | null) => void) — Required. Called when a complete valid date is entered or the field is cleared
  - mode (MaskitoDateMode) default: "dd/mm/yyyy" — Date format mode: dd/mm/yyyy, mm/dd/yyyy, yyyy/mm/dd, etc.
  - separator (string) default: "." — Character between date parts
  - timeMode (MaskitoTimeMode) — Enable time input: HH:MM, HH:MM:SS, etc.
  - dateTimeSeparator (string) default: ", " — Separator between date and time parts
  - timeStep (number) default: 0 — Arrow-key increment step for time segments
  - min (DateTime) — Earliest allowed date
  - max (DateTime) — Latest allowed date
  - clearable (boolean) default: false — Show clear button when input has a value
  - size (ControlSize) default: "md" — Input size (3xs to 3xl)
  - variant ("outline" | "soft") default: "outline" — Visual style
  - pill (boolean) default: false — Fully rounded corners
  - disabled (boolean) default: false — Disable input
  - invalid (boolean) default: false — Mark as invalid
  - placeholder (string) — Generated from the format if not set
Examples: Overview, With time, With seconds, Limits, US format, ISO format, With Field, Validation

## Date Picker
Date picker with an interactive calendar, time picker, year and month dropdowns, min/max limits, and date-of-birth presets.
Import: import { DatePicker } from "@plexui/ui/components/DatePicker"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/date-picker
Props:
  - value (DateTime | null) — Required. Selected date (luxon)
  - onChange ((date: DateTime | null) => void) — Required. Called when the date changes
  - id (string) — Id of the trigger, for forms and labels
  - min (DateTime) — Earliest selectable date (inclusive)
  - max (DateTime) — Latest selectable date (inclusive). Must not be before min
  - captionLayout ("buttons" | "dropdown") default: "buttons" — Calendar header mode. Use dropdown for date of birth
  - showTime (boolean) default: false — Show time input below calendar
  - yearRange ([number, number]) default: last 120 years — Min/max years for dropdown caption
  - size (ControlSize) default: "md" — Trigger size (3xs to 3xl)
  - variant ("outline" | "soft" | "ghost") default: "outline" — Trigger style
  - pill (boolean) default: true — Rounded trigger
  - block (boolean) default: false — Full-width trigger
  - clearable (boolean) default: false — Show clear button
  - triggerShowIcon (boolean) default: true — Show calendar icon
  - triggerDateFormat (string) default: "MM/dd/yy" — Date format in trigger. Auto-includes time when showTime is enabled and triggerTimeFormat is not set
  - triggerTimeFormat (string) — With showTime, the time format after the date in the trigger. The date and the time become two parts; in a phone row, two capsules
  - triggerClassName (string) — Class applied to the trigger
  - dropdownIconType ("dropdown" | "chevronDown" | "none") default: "dropdown" — Icon at the end of the trigger
  - placeholder (string) default: "Select date..." — Trigger placeholder
  - disabled (boolean) default: false — Disable picker
  - side ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left") default: "bottom" — Preferred side of the calendar popover. On phones, left and right prefer bottom so all seven day targets fit. Top and bottom keep their preference; collisions can still flip placement.
  - sideOffset (number) default: 8 — Distance from the trigger in pixels
  - align ("start" | "center" | "end") default: "center" — Alignment against the trigger
  - alignOffset (number) default: 0 (center), -5 (start, end) — Offset from start/end alignment in pixels
Examples: Overview, Limits, Date of birth, Time picker, Dropdown + time, Two fields, Date input, DateTime input, Without Icon

## Date Range Picker
Date range picker with an interactive calendar, min/max limits, preset shortcuts, and a month stepper for selecting start and end dates.
Import: import { DateRangePicker } from "@plexui/ui/components/DateRangePicker"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/date-range-picker
Props:
  - value (DateRange | null) — Required. Selected range ([start, end], inclusive)
  - onChange ((next: DateRange | null, shortcut?: DateRangeShortcut) => void) — Required. Called when the range changes
  - min (DateTime) — Earliest selectable date (inclusive)
  - max (DateTime) — Latest selectable date (inclusive). Must not be before min
  - maxRangeDays (number) — Max length of range in days (inclusive)
  - weekStartsOn (0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6) default: 0 — The day each week starts on, from 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday)
  - shortcuts (DateRangeShortcut[]) — Quick selection shortcuts ({ label, getDateRange }), shown next to the calendar from the md breakpoint up
  - side ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left") default: "bottom" — Preferred side of the calendar popover. On phones, left and right prefer bottom so all seven day targets fit. Top and bottom keep their preference; collisions can still flip placement.
  - sideOffset (number) default: 8 — Distance from trigger in pixels
  - align ("start" | "center" | "end") default: "center" — Preferred popover alignment
  - alignOffset (number) default: 0 (center), -5 (start, end) — Offset from start/end alignment in pixels
  - disabled (boolean) default: false — Disable picker interactions
  - placeholder (string) default: "Select date range..." — Placeholder in trigger when value is empty
  - variant ("soft" | "outline" | "ghost") default: "outline" — Trigger style variant
  - pill (boolean) default: true — Rounded trigger shape
  - size ("3xs" | "2xs" | "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl" | "3xl") default: "md" — Trigger size scale
  - dropdownIconType ("chevronDown" | "dropdown" | "none") default: "dropdown" — Icon shown at trigger end
  - triggerClassName (string) — Custom class for trigger
  - triggerShowIcon (boolean) default: true — Show calendar icon at trigger start
  - triggerStepperUnit ("month") — Enable month stepper mode in trigger
  - triggerDateFormat (string) default: "MM/dd/yy" — Date formatting in trigger text
  - clearable (boolean) default: false — Show clear button in trigger
  - block (boolean) default: false — Stretch trigger to full available width
Examples: Overview, Limits, Shortcuts, Month stepper

## Dialog
Modal dialog for confirmations, forms, and destructive alerts, with a focus trap, escape handling, and an overlay scrim.
Import: import { Dialog } from "@plexui/ui/components/Dialog"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/dialog
Props:
  - open (boolean) — Controlled open state; uncontrolled when omitted
  - onOpenChange ((open: boolean) => void) — Called when the dialog opens or closes
  Dialog.Content:
    - surface ("plain" | "grouped") default: "plain" — Mobile panel and field-group palette. Dark dialogs use elevated surface levels; desktop colors stay unchanged
    - width (number | string) default: 480 — Panel width. Mobile alert uses its compact width; a bottom sheet fills the viewport width
    - showClose (boolean) default: true — Show the built-in close button. Mobile sheet places it at the leading edge; mobile alert hides it
    - pill (boolean) default: false — Rounder panel and a round close button, for dialogs beside pill controls
    - className (string) — Additional CSS class on the panel
    - placement ("center" | "top" | "bottom" | "start" | "end" | "fullscreen") default: "center" — Where the panel sits: centered, near the top, a bottom sheet, a side panel, or the whole screen
    - mobileVariant ("alert" | "sheet") — Mobile appearance at 767px and below. Alert is compact and centered; sheet defaults to the bottom. Omit for the standard appearance
    - mobilePlacement ("center" | "bottom" | "fullscreen") — Placement at 767px and below. Defaults to bottom for sheet, otherwise placement. Alert stays centered
    - onOpenAutoFocus ((event: Event) => void) — Called when focus moves into the dialog on open; call event.preventDefault() to place it yourself, for example on the panel instead of the first field
    - onCloseAutoFocus ((event: Event) => void) — Called when focus returns on close; call event.preventDefault() to keep it elsewhere
  Dialog.Footer:
    - background ("soft" | "hard" | "glass" | "solid") default: "soft" — How the phone Sheet's bar meets the body scrolled under it, as on a Toolbar. Also available on the header; desktop and Alert surfaces are unchanged
    - mobileLayout ("inline" | "stacked") — Action layout at 767px and below. Defaults to inline for alert, stacked otherwise. Inline actions wrap when they do not fit
Examples: Overview, Destructive confirmation, Text field, Metadata details, Scrolling body, Placement, View options sheet, Segmented composer header, Setup choices

## Empty Message
Empty state for telling users there's nothing to show, with error, warning, no-results, and onboarding compositions.
Import: import { EmptyMessage } from "@plexui/ui/components/EmptyMessage"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/empty-message
Props:
  - fill ("static" | "absolute" | "none") default: "static" — How the container fills its parent: "static" takes full width and height, "absolute" covers a positioned parent (inset 0), "none" applies no sizing
  - size ("sm" | "md") default: "md" — sm is the compact message for a panel, a card section or an empty list
  - align ("center" | "start") default: "center" — start left-aligns the message, for an empty state under a section heading
  EmptyMessage.Icon:
    - color ("secondary" | "danger" | "warning") default: "secondary" — Semantic color
    - size ("sm" | "md") default: "md" — Icon badge size
  EmptyMessage.Title:
    - color ("secondary" | "danger" | "warning") default: "secondary" — Semantic color
  EmptyMessage.ActionRow:
    - className (string) — Additional classes for the action row container
Examples: Composition, Error message, Warning message, No results, Compact, Left aligned

## Field
Form field wrapper with a label, helper text, an error message, and automatic accessibility linking to its control.
Import: import { Field } from "@plexui/ui/components/Field"
Import: import { FieldGroup } from "@plexui/ui/components/FieldGroup"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/field
Props:
  - label (ReactNode) — Label text for the field
  - hideLabel (boolean) default: false — Hides the label from view; it still names the control. A description moves under the control. On a row the value or placeholder starts at the row's edge, so the row is vertical unless orientation says otherwise
  - description (ReactNode) — Helper text below the label; linked via aria-describedby
  - errorMessage (ReactNode) — Error message below the control; auto-sets aria-invalid on child
  - labelAction (ReactNode) — Content at the end of the label row, such as a link that acts on the field
  - size ("3xs" | "2xs" | "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl" | "3xl") default: child's size, else "md" — Label font size; defaults to the child control's size
  - required (boolean) default: false — Shows a required asterisk after the label (visual only)
  - orientation ("vertical" | "horizontal") default: "horizontal" on a row with a visible label, else "vertical" — Layout direction of label and control
  - row (boolean) default: false — One line of a FieldGroup. Clicking its non-interactive area focuses the text editor or activates the choice or popup control. Other div props reach the root only on a row
  - fill (boolean) default: false — On a row, the control takes the rest of the line after the label
  - action (ReactNode) — On a fill row, a control at the end of the row, such as a button that adds to a list. It stays on the list's first line, and on a phone it stands beside the label with the list under it
  - opticallyAlign ("start" | "end") — Applies optical alignment to the child control via negative margin using its gutter
  - id (string) — Override the auto-generated id used for htmlFor/aria linking. A child's own id wins: it stays, and htmlFor follows it
  - children (ReactElement | (fieldProps) => ReactNode) — Form control; receives id, aria-describedby and aria-invalid, plus aria-labelledby unless it has its own name. A render prop receives aria-labelledby to spread
  - className (string) — Applied to the root wrapper
  FieldGroup:
    - title (ReactNode) — Heading over the block; it names the group
    - headerProminence ("standard" | "increased") default: "standard" — How much the title stands out: a quiet heading over the rows, or a title that leads its content (on a phone the iOS prominent list header, 20pt Semibold)
    - description (ReactNode) — Line under the title
    - action (ReactNode) — Content at the end of the header. On a phone a ghost text button reads as the list header's action: tinted text on the title's last line
    - footer (ReactNode) — Content under the block, such as a note; its paragraphs stand apart
    - columns (boolean) default: false — Every value starts at one column, --field-row-column-width into the row, on the web and on a phone. Off, values end at the row's edge
    - bodyClassName (string) — Applied to the block that holds the rows
    - children (ReactNode) — The rows
    - className (string) — Applied to the root section
Examples: Overview, Group, Other controls, Label action, Several controls, Sizing, Optical alignment

## File Upload
Mobile-first file upload with MIME-type and size validation, multi-file selection, error states, and read-only file cards.
Import: import { FileUpload, FileCard, FileCardGroup } from "@plexui/ui/components/FileUpload"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/file-upload
Props:
  - variant ("compact" | "area") default: "compact" — Visual variant: compact button or larger tappable area
  - label (string) — Button label text
  - description (string) — Helper text below the icon (area variant only)
  - accept (string) — Accepted file types (e.g. ".pdf,.png,image/*")
  - multiple (boolean) default: false — Allow selecting multiple files. Without it, a new pick replaces the current file
  - maxFiles (number) — Maximum number of files. In multiple mode, the button disables at the limit. Single-file mode keeps the button available for replacement.
  - maxSize (number) — Maximum file size in bytes
  - value (File[]) — Controlled file list
  - onValueChange ((files: File[]) => void) — Callback when files are added or removed
  - onFileReject ((file: File, reason: string) => void) — Callback when a file is rejected (wrong type, too large, over limit)
  - errorMessage (string) — Error message. Sets the invalid visual state
  - invalid (boolean) default: false — Invalid state (auto-set when errorMessage is provided)
  - disabled (boolean) default: false — Disable all interactions
  - id (string) — Id of the hidden file input
  - className (string) — Additional CSS class
  FileCard:
    - file (File) — The file to display
    - onRemove (() => void) — Remove callback. When omitted, the delete button is hidden.
    - disabled (boolean) default: false — Disable the remove button
    - className (string) — Additional CSS class
  FileCardGroup:
    - children (ReactNode) — FileCard elements
    - className (string) — Additional CSS class
Examples: Overview, File list

## Float Input
Text input whose label floats above the value, with error and helper text, a clear button, a password reveal toggle, and a multi-line variant.
Import: import { FloatingLabelInput } from "@plexui/ui/components/FloatingLabelInput"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/floating-label-input
  FloatingLabelInput:
    - label (string) — Required. Floating label text
    - value (string) — Controlled value, with onChange
    - defaultValue (string) — Initial value when uncontrolled
    - errorMessage (string) — Validation message below input; sets invalid state
    - invalid (boolean) default: false (true if errorMessage) — Invalid visual state
    - description (ReactNode) — Helper text below the input
    - disabled (boolean) default: false — Disable input interactions
    - readOnly (boolean) default: false — Read-only input state
    - type (string) default: "text" — Input type; password gets a reveal toggle
    - revealable (boolean) default: true for password without an endAdornment — Built-in reveal toggle
    - multiline (boolean) default: false — Render as an auto-growing textarea
    - rows (number) default: 2 — Initial visible text lines when multiline is true
    - labelPlacement ("border" | "inside") default: "border" — Where the label rests once it floats. inside keeps it in the box, with the value under it, and always takes the rounded box
    - pill (boolean) default: true — Pill shape; false takes the rounded box of the other fields
    - allowAutofillExtensions (boolean) default: false — Let password-manager extensions decorate the input
    - startAdornment (ReactNode) — Content rendered before the input, inside the field. Always shown; keeps the label floated
    - endAdornment (ReactNode) — Content rendered after the input, before the clear button
    - onClear (() => void) — Shows a clear button when the input has a value; focus returns to the input
    - onRevealedChange ((revealed: boolean) => void) — Called when the reveal toggle is clicked
    - onAutofill (() => void) — Called when the browser autofills the input
  FloatingLabelSelect:
    - label (string) — Required. Floating label text
    - selected (boolean) default: false — Whether a value is selected: floats the label and shows the children
    - open (boolean) default: false — Whether the attached list is open
    - errorMessage (string) — Validation message below the field; sets invalid state
    - invalid (boolean) default: false (true if errorMessage) — Invalid visual state
    - disabled (boolean) default: false — Disable the field
    - labelPlacement ("border" | "inside") default: "border" — Where the label rests once it floats. inside keeps it in the box, with the value under it, and always takes the rounded box
    - pill (boolean) default: true — Pill shape; false takes the rounded box of the other fields
    - onClearClick (() => void) — Shows a clear button when a value is selected
    - onInteract (() => void) — Called on pointer down and on the keys that open the field. Without it those keys click the field, so a wrapping trigger opens
Examples: Overview, Types, Label inside, Rounded box, Textarea, Password input, Phone input, Select, Multiple selection, Country select, States

## Index Bar
"The section index of a phone list: a column of letters at the trailing edge that jumps to a section under the finger, as the iOS section index does. Desktop lists have no index, so an index bar never renders from 768px up."

  - items (string[]) — The titles of the sections, in order: usually letters, such as A to Z and #
  - onSelect ((item: string, index: number) => void) — Called with the title and the index of the section to show: on a press, on each new letter while dragging, and from the keys
  - id (string) — The id of the index bar
  - aria-label (string) default: "Section index" — Name of the index bar
  - aria-controls (string) — The id of the list the index scrolls

  - onBlur ((event: FocusEvent) => void) — Called when the index bar loses focus

## Indicators
Loading and progress indicators, from circular spinners and determinate progress rings to animated dots, with configurable color and stroke.
Import: import { LoadingIndicator, CircularProgress, LoadingDots } from "@plexui/ui/components/Indicator"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/indicators
  LoadingIndicator:
    - size (number | string) default: "1em" — Size in px or any CSS length. Defaults to 20px with the optional touch stylesheet, also inside a field. Also accepts --indicator-size.
    - strokeWidth (number) default: 2 — Ring stroke or mobile spoke width in px. Mobile spokes default to the iOS 27 kit proportion: 2/14 of the size up to 16px, 4/30 to 27px, 5/35 from 28px.
  CircularProgress:
    - progress (number) — Static progress 0-100 (disables the simulated animation)
    - done (boolean) default: false — Fills the ring and ends the simulated progress
    - maxDuration (number) default: 15000 — Duration of the simulated progress in ms
    - size (number | string) default: "28px" — Diameter in px or any CSS length
    - strokeWidth (number) default: 2 — Stroke thickness in px, capped at 4
    - trackColor (string) — Track color (CSS variable or value)
    - trackActiveColor (string) — Active segment color

## Markdown
Markdown renderer for rich formatted content, with headings, lists, tables, code blocks, and KaTeX math expressions out of the box.
Import: import { Markdown } from "@plexui/ui/components/Markdown"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/markdown
Props:
  - children (string) — Required. Markdown source
  - includeMath (boolean) default: false — Enable LaTeX math rendering
  - breakNewLines (boolean) default: false — Turn single newlines into line breaks
  - copyableCodeBlocks (boolean) default: true — Show a copy button on code blocks
  - collapsibleCodeBlocks (boolean) default: true — Render code blocks in the collapsible view with a View Code button
  - components (Record<string, MarkdownComponent>) — Tag name to component overrides, applied over the built-in ones
  - directives (MarkdownDirective[]) — Custom directives, each rendered by its own component
  - remarkPlugins (PluggableList) — Extra remark plugins, after the built-in ones
  - rehypePlugins (PluggableList) — Extra rehype plugins
  - allowedElements (string[]) — Only render these elements
  - disallowedElements (string[]) — Never render these elements
  - skipHtml (boolean) default: false — Ignore raw HTML in the source
  - urlTransform ((url: string) => string) — Rewrites URLs; the default drops unsafe protocols (javascript:) and keeps tel: and sms:
  - className (string) — Applied to the wrapping element
Examples: Overview, Math

## Menu
Dropdown menu for structured actions with grouped items, submenus, checkbox and radio items, and horizontal layouts.
Import: import { Menu } from "@plexui/ui/components/Menu"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/menu
Props:
  - forceOpen (boolean) — Keep menu open (controlled)
  - onOpen (() => void) — Called when menu opens
  - onClose (() => void) — Called when menu closes
  - modal (boolean) default: false — Whether menu is modal (focus trap)
  Menu.Trigger:
    - disabled (boolean) default: false — Prevent the menu from opening
  Menu.Content:
    - width (number | "auto") default: "auto" — Panel width in px
    - minWidth (number | "auto") default: 300 — Minimum panel width in px (vertical layout)
    - maxHeight (number) — Maximum panel height in px
    - pill (boolean) default: false — Rounder list with fully rounded rows, for menus beside pill controls. Menu.SubContent takes it too
    - side ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left") default: "bottom" — Preferred placement. Without it, and without sideOffset, a menu on a phone opens upward from a trigger in the lower half of the screen
    - sideOffset (number) default: 5 — Distance from the trigger in px. Without it a menu on a phone covers its trigger
    - align ("start" | "center" | "end") default: "center" — Alignment relative to trigger
    - alignOffset (number) default: -5 — Offset from the start or end alignment in px. 0 with center alignment, and on a phone when the menu covers its trigger
    - layout ("vertical" | "horizontal") default: "vertical" — Layout direction. Use horizontal for icon toolbars
    - size ("sm" | "md" | "lg") default: "md" — Size of horizontal menu items (icon size + padding)
    - onCloseAutoFocus ((event: Event) => void) — Called before focus returns to the trigger; call event.preventDefault() to keep it from moving there
    - onOpenAutoFocus ((event: Event) => void) — Called before focus moves into the menu as it opens; call event.preventDefault() to leave focus where it is, as for a menu that stands open when its screen appears
  Menu.Item:
    - description (ReactNode) — Second line under the label. The label turns semibold on its own
    - onSelect ((event: Event) => void) — Called when item is selected; call event.preventDefault() to keep the menu open
    - onClick ((event: MouseEvent) => void) — Called when the item is clicked; also makes the item interactive
    - disabled (boolean) default: false — Disable the item
    - danger (boolean) default: false — Destructive action: the item is drawn in the danger color
    - className (string) — Applied to the item
  Menu.Header:
    - media (ReactNode) — Picture before the title: an image, an icon or an Avatar in a 32px square (40px on a phone). An image or icon fills it; an image gets small rounded corners
    - description (ReactNode) — Line under the title, such as the kind and size of a file
    - action (ReactNode) — Round action at the end: a Menu.HeaderAction
    - className (string) — Applied to the header
  Menu.HeaderAction:
    - aria-label (string) — Accessible name of the icon-only action (required)
    - onSelect ((event: Event) => void) — Called when the action is pressed; call event.preventDefault() to keep the menu open
    - disabled (boolean) default: false — Disable the action
  Menu.CheckboxItem:
    - checked (boolean | "indeterminate") — Checked state
    - onCheckedChange ((checked: boolean) => void) — When checkbox toggles
    - onSelect ((event: Event) => void) — Use with preventDefault() to keep menu open
    - indicatorPosition ("start" | "end") default: "end" — Checkbox position
    - indicatorVariant ("solid" | "ghost") default: "solid" — Checkbox indicator style
    - disabled (boolean) — Disable the item
Examples: Overview, Natural sizing, Horizontal (icons only), Mode switch, Header, Grouped items, Submenus, Checkbox items, Radio items, Item actions, Destructive items

## Popover
A floating panel for contextual UI, with flexible sizing, hover triggers, a controllable open state and nesting.
Import: import { Popover } from "@plexui/ui/components/Popover"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/popover

  - open (boolean) — Controlled open state; uncontrolled when omitted
  - onOpenChange ((nextState: boolean) => void) — Called when the popover opens or closes
  - showOnHover (boolean) default: false — Open on hover and focus instead of click

    - minWidth (number | "auto") default: 300 — Minimum panel width in px
    - maxWidth (number) default: 700 — Maximum panel width in px, capped by the space available in the viewport
    - side ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left") default: "bottom" — Preferred placement; flips when it collides
    - align ("start" | "center" | "end") default: "center" — Alignment relative to trigger
    - sideOffset (number) default: 8 — Offset from trigger (px)
    - alignOffset (number) default: -5 — Offset from the start or end alignment (px)
    - avoidCollisions (boolean) default: true — Reposition to stay inside the viewport and scroll containers
    - collisionPadding (number) default: 20 — Space in px to keep from viewport and scroll container boundaries
    - translucent (boolean) default: false — Translucent, blurred surface
    - autoFocus (boolean) default: true — Move focus into the panel when it opens (hover popovers never take focus)
    - data-* (string) — Data attributes land on the panel
    - className (string) — Applied to the panel

## Progress
A horizontal bar that shows task completion, with determinate and indeterminate modes, labelled layouts, and smooth value transitions.
Import: import { Progress } from "@plexui/ui/components/Progress"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/progress
Props:
  - value (number | null) default: null — Current progress between 0 and max. Pass null for indeterminate.
  - max (number) default: 100 — Maximum progress value
  - getValueLabel ((value: number, max: number) => string) default: — — Accessible value text (aria-valuetext). Defaults to the rounded percentage, e.g. "67%".
  - className (string) default: — — Applied to the root <div>
Examples: Overview, With label, Controlled

  - defaultValue (string) — Initial selected value (uncontrolled)
  - onChange ((value: string) => void) — Called when selected option changes

    - required (boolean) — Marks this item as required

## Select Control
Select control primitive for building custom dropdowns, with variants, sizing, start and dropdown icons, and clearable, loading, and invalid states.
Import: import { SelectControl } from "@plexui/ui/components/SelectControl"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/select-control
Props:
  - selected (boolean) default: false — Whether a value is selected (affects placeholder styling)
  - variant ("soft" | "outline" | "ghost") default: "outline" — Visual variant
  - size (ControlSize) default: "md" — Control size (3xs to 3xl)
  - pill (boolean) default: false — Fully rounded trigger
  - StartIcon (ComponentType) — Icon at start
  - onClearClick (() => void) — Enables the clear button when set
  - interactOnEnter (boolean) default: false — Enter interacts too, as on a combobox button. Off by default, as Enter may be an attempt to submit a form
  - onInteract (() => void) — Called on pointer down, ArrowDown, ArrowUp and Space. Without it, a wrapping trigger opens on pointer down
  - dropdownIconType ("chevronDown" | "dropdown" | "none") default: "dropdown" — Dropdown indicator style
  - invalid (boolean) default: false — Invalid state
  - disabled (boolean) default: false — Disable control
  - block (boolean) default: false — Full width
  - loading (boolean) default: false — Loading state (aria-busy); hides the indicators and ignores interaction
  - opticallyAlign ("start" | "end") — Optical alignment
  - className (string) — Applied to the control
Examples: Overview, Variants, Sizing & roundness, Selected, Start icon, Dropdown icon, Clearable, Loading, Invalid, Disabled, Block, Country selector, Country code selector, Phone form, Optical alignment

## Select
Select dropdown with grouped options, per-item descriptions, multiple selection, action items, and column-based layouts.
Import: import { Select } from "@plexui/ui/components/Select"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/select
Props:
  - options (Options<T>) — Array of options or grouped options
  - value (string | string[]) — Selected value (single) or values (multiple)
  - onChange ((option: T) => void | (options: T[]) => void) — Called when selection changes, with the selected option (or options with multiple)
  - multiple (boolean) default: false — Allow multiple selection
  - placeholder (string) default: "Select..." — Trigger placeholder
  - variant ("soft" | "outline" | "ghost") default: "outline" — Trigger variant
  - size (ControlSize) default: "md" — Trigger size (3xs to 3xl)
  - pill (boolean) default: false — Rounded trigger
  - clearable (boolean) default: false — Show clear button
  - block (boolean) default: variant !== "ghost" — Full width trigger
  - disabled (boolean) default: false — Disable select. A disabled select is not submitted or validated with its form
  - loading (boolean) default: false — Loading state; shows loadingPlaceholder and keeps the menu closed
  - loadingPlaceholder (string) default: "Loading..." — Trigger text while loading
  - allSelectedLabel (string) default: "All selected" — Text of a multiple trigger when every option is selected
  - name (string) — Name of the hidden form input. With multiple, every selected value is submitted
  - required (boolean) — Required for native form validation
  - id (string) — Id of the hidden form input
  - actions (array) — Actions below options list
  - checkPosition ("start" | "end" | "none") default: "start" — Where the check indicator sits in the list. "none" removes the indicator column for lists that never carry a selection
  - OptionView (React.FC) — Custom option render
  - TriggerView (React.FC) — Custom trigger render: the selected option, or { values, selectedAll } with multiple
  - TriggerStartIcon (ComponentType) — Icon at the start of the trigger
  - trigger (({ open, onToggle }) => ReactNode) — Custom trigger element, wrapped as the popover trigger
  - dropdownIconType ("chevronDown" | "dropdown" | "none") default: "dropdown" — Indicator at the end of the trigger
  - side ("top" | "bottom") default: "bottom" — Preferred side of the list
  - align ("start" | "center" | "end") default: "end" at the end of a Field row ("start" in a FieldGroup with columns), "center" when block, otherwise "start" — Alignment of the list against the trigger
  - listWidth (number | "auto") default: trigger width (fits the options when not block or at the end of a Field row) — Width of the list in px
  - listMinWidth (number | "auto") default: trigger width — Minimum width of the list in px
  - listMaxWidth (number | "auto") default: "auto" (300 when it fits the options) — Maximum width of the list in px
  - searchPlaceholder (string) — Search input placeholder
  - searchAriaLabel (string) default: "Search options" — Accessible name of the search input, independent of the trigger label
  - searchEmptyMessage (ReactNode) default: "No results found." — Shown when the search matches nothing
  - searchSize (ControlSize) default: "md" — Size of the search input in the menu, such as 2xl for 44px touch targets on phones
  - searchPredicate ((option, term) => boolean) — Filters options while searching
  - aria-label / aria-labelledby (string) — Accessible name of the trigger and the list
Examples: Overview, With descriptions, Actions, Grouped options, Multiple selection, Column configuration

## Sidebar
Composable navigation sidebar for app shells with collapsible sections, search and filter, tree views with hover actions, and a mobile menu
Import: import { SidebarProvider, SidebarLayout, Sidebar, SidebarHeader, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarInset, SidebarTrigger } from "@plexui/ui/components/Sidebar"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/sidebar
Props:
  - variant ("sidebar" | "docs") default: "sidebar" — Visual variant
  - side ("left" | "right") default: "left" — Which side the sidebar is on
  SidebarProvider:
    - collapsible ("offcanvas" | "icon" | "none") default: "offcanvas" — Collapse behavior: offcanvas (drawer on mobile, full collapse on desktop), icon (icon rail), or none
    - variant ("sidebar" | "app") default: "sidebar" — Look of the whole shell. "app" is the sidebar of a product: 260px, pill rows on a grey ground, a page with no inset, and on a phone a menu under the page
    - defaultOpen (boolean) default: true — Initial open state (uncontrolled)
    - open (boolean) — Controlled open state
    - onOpenChange ((open: boolean) => void) — Called when open state changes. Without open the provider keeps its own state and still calls it
    - className (string) — Class of the provider's wrapper
    - style (CSSProperties) — Style of the provider's wrapper, e.g. --sidebar-width
  SidebarGroup:
    - defaultOpen (boolean) default: true — Whether the group is open initially. A closed group hides its SidebarGroupContent
    - open (boolean) — Controlled open state, also exposed as data-state. The group has no toggle of its own: change open from your own control
  SidebarGroupLabel:
    - size ("sm" | "lg") default: "lg" — sm: compact, tertiary. lg: larger, primary, more spacing
    - asChild (boolean) default: false — Render the single child element as the label
  SidebarMenuItem:
    - expanded (boolean) — Marks the item expanded, which turns its SidebarMenuChevron. Pair it with open on its SidebarMenuSub
  SidebarMenuButton:
    - isActive (boolean) default: false — Highlight the current page (aria-current="page")
    - tooltip (string | ReactNode) — Label shown on hover when collapsed (icon mode). Hidden on mobile.
    - asChild (boolean) default: false — Render the single child element (e.g. a router link) as the button. The button attributes go on the child and its content is wrapped like the button's
  SidebarMenuSub:
    - open (boolean) default: true — Whether submenu is expanded. A closed submenu is inert, so its links and buttons leave the tab order and the accessibility tree
    - hasIcons (boolean) default: false — Align child items with parent text that has icons
  SidebarMenuSubButton:
    - isActive (boolean) default: false — Highlight the current page (aria-current="page")
    - indent (0 | 1 | 2 | 3) default: 0 — Nesting level; each level adds 12px of left margin
    - asChild (boolean) default: false — Render the single child element (e.g. a router link) as the button
  SidebarCard:
    - variant ("default" | "elevated") default: "default" — Visual variant
    - dismissible (boolean) default: false — Shows dismiss button
    - onDismiss (() => void) — Callback when dismissed
Examples: App Shell, App, Basic, Collapsible Sections, Search and Filter, Tree with Hover Actions, Mobile Menu, Search Input

## Slider
Slider for fine-tuning numeric values with single or range thumbs, marks, an editable value input, and vertical orientation.
Import: import { Slider } from "@plexui/ui/components/Slider"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/slider
Props:
  - value (number | number[]) — Required. Current value; array when range is true
  - min (number) — Required. Minimum value
  - max (number) — Required. Maximum value
  - step (number) — Required. Step increment
  - range (boolean) default: false — Enable multi-thumb range mode
  - orientation ("horizontal" | "vertical") default: "horizontal" — Layout direction of the slider
  - resetValue (number) — Value for reset option (single mode only)
  - resetTooltip (string) default: "Reset to default" — Tooltip and accessible name of the reset button
  - unit (string) — Unit displayed (e.g. ms, px)
  - prefixUnit (string) — Unit displayed before the value (e.g. $)
  - label (ReactNode) — Label (string or JSX). Also names the slider thumbs for assistive technology
  - aria-label (string) — Accessible name when there is no visible label. Range thumbs add Minimum / Maximum (or Value n of m)
  - aria-labelledby (string) — Id of an element that names the slider; takes precedence over label
  - marks (Array<{ value: number, label: string }>) — Marks below track (horizontal only)
  - onChange ((value: number | number[]) => void) — Required. Change handler; receives array when range is true
  - minStepsBetweenThumbs (number) — Minimum steps between thumbs (range mode only)
  - disabled (boolean) default: false — Disable slider
  - trackColor (string) — Color of the slider track
  - rangeColor (string) — Color of the filled range
  - className (string) — Applied to the root element
  - onFocus ((event: FocusEvent) => void) — Called when the value input or a thumb gains focus
  - onBlur ((event: FocusEvent) => void) — Called when the value input or a thumb loses focus
Examples: Overview, Adding a tooltip, Marks, Range, Multiple thumbs, Vertical

## Sortable
"Reorders a list by dragging: rows of a group, table rows, images, tags and cards. The order changes on the drop."
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/sortable
Props:
  - value (T[]) — The list, in the order of the children
  - onChange ((value: T[]) => void) — Called with the new order after a drop
  - layout ('list' | 'grid') default: list — list for rows one under another, grid for items that stand side by side
  - as (ElementType) default: div — Element to render, such as TableBody for table rows
  - disabled (boolean) default: false — Turns dragging off
  - handles (boolean) default: true in a table, otherwise false — Shows the grips of Sortable.Handle. A hidden grip still takes the keyboard, and the item drags from anywhere but a control
  - group (string) — Lists of one group trade items, and a Sortable.Target of that group takes them. Give each list a name
  - name (string) — Names the list in onMove
  - onMove ((move: SortableMove<T>) => void) — An item moved, inside this list or out of it, with { item, from, fromIndex, to, toIndex }. Out of it the app updates both lists: onChange is for a move inside one
  - onHold ((name: string) => void) — A drag rests on a Sortable.Target of the group for half a second
  - children (ReactNode) — The items: one direct child per entry of value, keyed by the entry and not by its index
  - aria-label (string) default: Reorder — Name of the handle for assistive technology
Examples: Rows, Rows with a handle, Stacked rows, Different controls, Table, Images, Tags, Cards, Between lists

## Stepper
Two segments that decrease and increase a number in steps, within a range or wrapping around, as the iOS 26 stepper does.
Import: import { Stepper } from "@plexui/ui/components/Stepper"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/stepper
Props:
  - value (number) — Controlled value
  - defaultValue (number) default: min — Initial value (uncontrolled)
  - onChange ((value: number) => void) — Called with the next value after a step
  - min (number) default: 0 — Lowest value
  - max (number) default: 100 — Highest value
  - step (number) default: 1 — Amount each step adds or removes
  - wrap (boolean) default: false — A step past max continues from min, and one below min from max
  - autoRepeat (boolean) default: true — Holding a segment keeps stepping: after 400ms, every 100ms
  - disabled (boolean) default: false — Prevent interaction and focus
  - pill (boolean) default: true — Fully rounded ends
  - decrementLabel (string) default: "Decrease" — Accessible name of the minus segment
  - incrementLabel (string) default: "Increase" — Accessible name of the plus segment

  - aria-label (string) — Name of the value, when no visible label names it
  - aria-labelledby (string) — The id of the visible label of the value
  - aria-describedby (string) — The id of an element that describes the stepper
  - id (string) — The id of the stepper
  - onFocus (FocusEventHandler<HTMLDivElement>) — Called when the stepper gains focus
  - onBlur (FocusEventHandler<HTMLDivElement>) — Called when the stepper loses focus
  - className (string) — CSS classes applied to the stepper

## Tab Bar
"The tab bar of a phone screen: two to five sections at the bottom in a floating glass capsule, an optional search or prominent tab, minimizing while the content scrolls. Desktop layouts navigate with a Sidebar or Tabs, so a tab bar never renders from 768px up."
Import: import { TabBar } from "@plexui/ui/components/TabBar"

  - defaultValue (string) — Selected tab (uncontrolled)

    - disabled (boolean) default: false — The tab cannot be selected

## Table
Styled table primitives for structured data, with header, body, footer, row, cell and caption parts on native table elements.
Import: import { Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell } from "@plexui/ui/components/Table"
Import: import { DataTable, DataTableColumnHeader } from "@plexui/ui/components/DataTable"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/table
  Table Primitives:
    - Table (table) — Root table container with horizontal scroll wrapper
    - TableHeader (thead) — Table header group
    - TableBody (tbody) — Table body group
    - TableFooter (tfoot) — Table footer group
    - TableRow (tr) — Table row
    - TableHead (th) — Table header cell
    - TableCell (td) — Table data cell
    - TableCaption (caption) — Table caption
  DataTable:
    - columns (ColumnDef<TData>[]) — Column definitions following TanStack Table v8 API (required)
    - data (TData[]) — Data array to display (required)
    - variant ("default" | "bordered") default: "default" — Visual variant: bordered adds a rounded border and tinted header
    - pageSize (number) default: 10 — Rows per page. Set 0 or Infinity to disable pagination. The rows-per-page select offers 10, 20, 50, 100 and this size
    - initialSorting (SortingState) — Initial column sorting state
    - globalFilter (string) — Controlled search/filter string
    - onGlobalFilterChange ((value: string) => void) — Callback when filter changes
    - onRowClick ((row: TData) => void) — Click handler for rows. Makes rows interactive: they take Tab and call it on Enter or Space
    - columnVisibility (VisibilityState) — Controlled column visibility state
    - onColumnVisibilityChange ((visibility: VisibilityState) => void) — Callback when visibility changes
    - enableRowSelection (boolean) default: false — Adds a first column (id select) with a checkbox per row and a header checkbox that selects every row on all pages, mixed when some are selected. A click on a checkbox is not a row click
    - rowSelection (RowSelectionState) — Controlled row selection state
    - onRowSelectionChange ((selection: RowSelectionState) => void) — Callback when selection changes
    - getRowId ((row: TData) => string) — Custom row ID accessor; selection keys use it
    - emptyMessage (ReactNode) default: "No results." — Shown when no rows
    - showPagination (boolean) default: true — Whether to show pagination controls. They hide on their own when every row fits on one page
    - className (string) — Class applied to outermost wrapper
  DataTableColumnHeader:
    - column (Column<TData, TValue>) — TanStack Table column object (required)
    - title (string) — Display text for the header (required)
    - className (string) — Class applied to the header button (or text when the column cannot sort)
  Column helpers:
    - idCell(accessor) (CellComponent) — Monospace ID with copy-on-click tooltip
    - dateTimeCell(accessor, options?) (CellComponent) — Formatted datetime with Intl.DateTimeFormat
    - statusCell(accessor, colorMap?) (CellComponent) — Badge cell with automatic status-to-color mapping
    - tooltipHeader(label, description) (HeaderComponent) — Header with dashed underline and info tooltip
Examples: Overview, With footer, Minimal, Variant, Sorting, Pagination, Row click, Row selection, Cell variants, Filtering, Column visibility

## Tabs
Switch between grouped views with segmented or underline tabs, icon-only triggers, and badge counts on each tab.
Import: import { Tabs } from "@plexui/ui/components/Tabs"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/tabs
Props:
  - value (string) — Selected tab value (controlled, required)
  - onChange ((value: string) => void) — Called when selection changes
  - onClick (() => void) — Called on any click in the group, even when the selection does not change
  - variant ("segmented" | "underline") default: "segmented" — Visual style: segmented (background highlight) or underline (line indicator)
  - orientation ("horizontal" | "vertical") default: "horizontal" — Layout direction of the tab group
  - size (ControlSize) default: "md" — Control height (3xs through 3xl)
  - gutterSize ("2xs" | "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl") — Horizontal padding of tabs
  - pill (boolean) default: true — Fully rounded control (segmented variant only)
  - flush (boolean) default: false — Text-width indicator, no border, gap spacing (underline variant only)
  - block (boolean) default: false — Full-width control with equal-width tabs
  - disabled (boolean) default: false — Disable all tabs
  - aria-label (string) — Accessible name (required)
  - overflow ("scroll" | "menu") default: "scroll" — Tabs that do not fit: scroll sideways, or move into a menu at the end (horizontal, not block)
  - overflowLabel (string) default: "More" — Text of the menu button with overflow="menu"
  - className (string) — Extra classes on the group element
  - children (ReactNode) — Tabs.Tab children
  Tabs.Tab:
    - value (string) — Tab value (required)
    - disabled (boolean) — Disable this tab
    - icon (ReactNode) — Icon element (sized automatically)
    - badge (ReactNode | { content: ReactNode; color?: "secondary" | "success" | "danger" | "warning" | "info" | "discovery" | "caution"; variant?: "soft" | "solid"; pill?: boolean; loading?: boolean }) — Badge content (for example a count) or a badge config
    - aria-label (string) — Accessible name (required for icon-only tabs)
    - children (ReactNode) — Tab label
Examples: Overview, Segmented with icons, Icon only, Segmented with badge, Underline, Underline flush, Underline block, Underline with icons, Underline with badge, Vertical segmented, Vertical underline, Vertical underline with icons, Sizing, Scrollable, Overflow menu

## Tag Input
Input for entering multiple unique values as chip-style tokens, with suggestions and keyboard editing.
Import: import { TagInput } from "@plexui/ui/components/TagInput"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/tag-input
Props:
  - value (Tag[]) — Controlled value
  - defaultValue (Tag[]) — Uncontrolled initial tags
  - onChange ((tags: Tag[]) => void) — Change handler
  - id (string) — Id of the text input, so a label can target it with htmlFor
  - placeholder (string) — Input placeholder
  - validator ((value: string) => boolean) — Validates each tag when it is created; invalid tags shown in red
  - maxTags (number) — Maximum number of tags. At the limit the text input hides and a count shows below; the container then takes the tab stop, so arrow keys and Backspace still select and remove tags
  - rows (number) default: 1 — Min rows
  - size ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | '2xl' | '3xl') default: xl — Control height when rows=1; matches Input height of the same size
  - pill (boolean) default: false — Fully-rounded container and chips; matches Input/SelectControl pill
  - delimiters (string[]) default: [",", " "] — Characters that commit the current text as a tag
  - disabled (boolean) — Disables the input: tags cannot be added or removed, and pending text stays as typed
  - autoFocus (boolean) default: false — Focus on mount
Examples: Overview, Inline filter row, Suggestions

## Text Link
Text link for inline internal and external links with router integration, color inheritance, underline control, and weight options.
Import: import { TextLink } from "@plexui/ui/components/TextLink"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/text-link
Props:
  - children (ReactNode) — Link content
  - href (string) — URL. An http:// or https:// URL is external
  - to (string | object) — Router link destination (internal); its type comes from the link component
  - primary (boolean) default: false — Primary color, no default underline
  - underline (boolean) default: true — Underline (default true unless primary)
  - forceExternal (boolean) — Force external link behavior
  - as (Component) — Link component (e.g. Next Link)
  - target (string) — Where to open the link. External links default to _blank
  - className (string) — Extra classes on the link
Examples: Overview, Inline usage, Default inheritance, Primary color, Underline, External links, Font weight

## Textarea
Multi-line text input that can grow with its content, with a size scale, autofill extension control, and invalid state styling.
Import: import { Textarea } from "@plexui/ui/components/Textarea"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/textarea
Props:
  - value (string | number) — Controlled value; uncontrolled when omitted
  - defaultValue (string | number) — Initial value when uncontrolled
  - onChange ((event: ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void) — Called on every input
  - variant ("outline" | "soft" | "ghost") default: "outline" — Visual style of the textarea; ghost has no border and no fill, for a row or a container that frames it
  - size ("3xs" | "2xs" | "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl" | "3xl") default: "md" — Control height for single-line equivalent
  - gutterSize ("2xs" | "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl") — Horizontal padding; defaults from size
  - disabled (boolean) default: false — Disable the textarea
  - readOnly (boolean) default: false — Make the textarea read-only
  - invalid (boolean) default: false — Mark as invalid
  - allowAutofillExtensions (boolean) default: !!name — Allow autofill extensions
  - autoSelect (boolean) default: false — Select all contents when mounted
  - rows (number) default: 3 — Initial row count
  - autoResize (boolean) default: false — Grow/shrink with content
  - maxRows (number) — Max rows when autoResize; defaults to the larger of rows and 10
  - onAutofill (() => void) — Called when the browser autofills the textarea
  - className (string) — Applied to the container <div>
  - ref (Ref<HTMLTextAreaElement>) — Ref to the <textarea>
Examples: Overview, Variants, Auto resize, Sizing, Disabled, Invalid, Auto select text, Autofill extensions

## Tip
A short message that points out a feature people might miss, inside the page or anchored to a control, as TipKit tips do.
Import: import { Tip } from "@plexui/ui/components/Tip"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/tip
Props:
  - title (ReactNode) — The tip's title: what the feature is
  - description (ReactNode) — One or two sentences on how to use it
  - icon (ReactNode) — A symbol or image that leads the message
  - actions (ReactNode) — Buttons for the tip's actions, side by side below the message
  - onClose (() => void) — Shows the Close button; called when it is clicked
  - arrowEdge ("top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right") — Draws an arrow at this edge, pointing at what the tip explains
  - className (string) — CSS classes applied to the tip
  - ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>) — Ref applied to the tip
  Tip.Popover:
    - open (boolean) — Shows the tip (controlled)
    - defaultOpen (boolean) default: false — Shows the tip at first (uncontrolled)
    - onOpenChange ((open: boolean) => void) — Called when the tip opens or closes
    - side ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left") default: "bottom" — The side of the control the tip shows on, turned when it does not fit
    - align ("start" | "center" | "end") default: "center" — The alignment against the control
    - sideOffset (number) default: 4 — The distance from the control to the arrow's point, in pixels
    - closeButton (boolean) default: true — Shows the Close button
    - className (string) — CSS classes applied to the popover around the tip and its arrow
Examples: Overview, Actions, Arrow, Popover

## Toast
Toast notifications for transient feedback, with semantic variants, descriptions, action buttons, promise integration, and persistent toasts.
Import: import { Toaster, toast } from "@plexui/ui/components/Toast"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/toast
  Toaster:
    - position ("top-left" | "top-center" | "top-right" | "bottom-left" | "bottom-center" | "bottom-right") default: "top-center" — Where toasts anchor on the viewport
    - duration (number) default: 3000 — Default auto-dismiss duration in ms
    - offset (string | number | { top?; right?; bottom?; left? }) — Distance from the viewport edge
    - mobileOffset (string | number | { top?; right?; bottom?; left? }) default: 16px + safe area per edge — Mobile viewport gutter. Explicit edges override their safe defaults; omitted edges keep them.
    - gap (number) — Gap between stacked toasts in px
Examples: Overview, Variants, Description, Action, Promise, Long content, Compact, Persistent

## Toolbar
"The top and bottom bars of a phone screen: navigation, a title, a search field and actions over the content. Desktop layouts have their own composition, so a toolbar never renders from 768px up."
Import: import { Toolbar } from "@plexui/ui/components/Toolbar"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/toolbar
Props:
  - placement ("top" | "bottom") default: "top" — Top bar with 44px targets, or bottom bar with 48px targets
  - titleStyle ("inline" | "large" | "compact-large" | "compact-medium") default: "inline" — Size and place of Toolbar.Title in a top bar
  - titleAlign ("center" | "start") default: "center" — Alignment of an inline title. Large and compact titles always start at the leading edge
  - background ("soft" | "hard" | "glass" | "solid") default: "soft" — How the bar meets the content scrolled under it, see Background. "edge" is the earlier name of "soft"
  - className (string) default: — — Applied to the bar
  Toolbar.Title:
    - subtitle (ReactNode) default: — — Second, smaller line below the title
    - as ("h1" | "h2" | "h3") default: "h1" — Heading level of the title
Examples: Overview, Titles, Group, Search, Bottom, Background, Disabled, Sheet

## Tooltip
Brief informative text shown on hover or focus, for any trigger element, with conditional enabling and a compact variant.
Import: import { Tooltip } from "@plexui/ui/components/Tooltip"
Docs: https://plexui.com/components/tooltip
Props:
  - children (ReactElement) — The trigger: a single element. Wrap plain text in Tooltip.TriggerDecorator
  - content (ReactNode) — Tooltip content (null = no tooltip)
  - compact (boolean) default: false — Short 1-3 word tooltips, inverse styling
  - interactive (boolean) default: false — Content is interactive, stays open when hovered
  - maxWidth (number | "none") default: 300 — Max width of tooltip
  - openDelay (number) default: 150 — Delay before showing (ms)
  - side ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left") default: "top" — Preferred side
  - sideOffset (number) default: 5 — Distance from trigger
  - align ("start" | "center" | "end") default: "center" — Alignment
  - alignOffset (number) default: 0 — Alignment offset
  - gutterSize ("sm" | "md" | "lg") default: "md" — Content padding
  - contentClassName (string) — Class for tooltip content
  - forceOpen (boolean) — Force open or closed
  - preventUnintentionalClickToClose (true) — Keeps the tooltip open when the trigger is clicked right after it opened
Examples: Overview, Different triggers, Conditionally enabled, Compact tooltips
